snippet.title: Not Monsters Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Not Monsters is officially live on Steam! 🎉
Wishlist it now and join us as we build the game alongside the community - with playtests, new roles, monsters and more coming soon.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879320/Not_Monsters/#game_area_purchase&utm_source=actuator-youtube
🌐 Website: https://notmonsters.actuator.games/
